test_title: PYST 1: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 20 Feb, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
'I × J' means 'I is the mother of J'

'I + J' means 'I is the husband of J'

'I ÷ J' means 'I is the sister of J'

'I - J' means 'I is the brother of J'

How is Q related to Z in the expression 'Q ÷ X + Y × Z'?
solution:
Symbol
 ÷
 +
 ×
 -
 
 

 Meaning
 Sister
 Husband
 Mother
 Brother
 
 

**
Q ÷ X + Y × Z → Q is the sister of X; X is the husband of Y; Y is the mother of Z. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d5df405191322742ae9fa10bc50efdb0cb5c7ddcf0421e61bb8812f46b9813d6.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/50814a4b520cace4818ad732b7a35ea2a1aaef2b8213724e03d5e0d726ea0b9b.png] 

So, Q is Z's father's sister. 

Hence,** **the correct answer is** **"Option 1".**
